critical_code_review_comments: mall_v2.py reviews try/except still catches duplicate-key by string-matching 'duplicate key' / 'E11000' in str(e) rather than catching pymongo.errors.DuplicateKeyError directly. Functionally equivalent today but more fragile across pymongo versions. Recommend `except DuplicateKeyError:` for explicitness (the iteration_243 review note still applies).

mall_v2.py AI description endpoint logs/returns a generic 502 message on Exception, which is good — but still re-raises HTTPException 500 from review insert (line ~220) on non-duplicate insert failures; consider distinguishing transient DB errors with 503.
mall_v2.py creates its own AsyncIOMotorClient at import time rather than reusing server.py's shared db (carried-over flag from iter_243).

ParasMall.js fix is correct — track-view useEffect is now declared before `if (loading) return …`, restoring stable hook order. Recommend a small unit test or eslint-plugin-react-hooks/exhaustive-deps to guard against regressions.

rca_of_the_issue: Bug 1 (AI desc 502) RCA: emergentintegrations.llm.chat.LlmChat dropped/renamed .with_max_tokens() in current installed version. Fix in mall_v2.py lines ~497-510 removes the chained `.with_max_tokens(220)` call and converts the 502 message to generic. Verified by curl + pytest. Bug 2 (hooks error) RCA: track-view useEffect was placed after `if (loading) return (...)` in ParasMall.js, so on the first render (loading=true) only N-1 hooks ran, and on the second render (loading=false) all N hooks ran → React threw 'Rendered more hooks than the previous render', and downstream Mall 2.0 widgets failed to mount. Fix: moved the useEffect above the early-return guard and used `filtered[activeIndex]?.product_id` (computed before the guard) as its dep. Verified via Playwright pageerror listener returning 0 errors and all testids present.
